keyFindings.description: A boot-time StalePlugin whose launch the lifecycle check or the store refuses (launch returns checkLaunch's error before letGo, machine.go:828-831) leaves the claim live with its capability hash and stale contract; the event is posted once (daemon.go:1143-1155) and a failed decision is only logged (supervisor.go:176-195), so every call that process makes is refused 409 'the daemon is relaunching this process onto the current plugin' with no relaunch under way, until the next daemon restart. Reproduced with a throwaway supervise test: after a CheckLaunch error the claim stays ready, hashLen 10, pluginContract 0, Resume calls 0. Fix in this PR: a retry (re-post StalePlugin for stale live claims at each orphan sweep, as StaleAddress re-arrives every sweep; or re-post from the refusing route), and/or key the 409 on a relaunch actually started.

No `## Contract change census` section, though the PR adds refusals (409 STALE_PLUGIN_CONTRACT; the exact-version refusal of runtime.kubernetes.plugins; the wrapper's contract refusal before exec), makes fields required (pluginContract on the three strict zod mirrors; both keys of runtime.kubernetes.plugins), changes `legion version`'s output shape, and changes package-boundary signatures (store.RegisterController, supervise.Deps, runtime.SpawnSpec.Plugins, sandbox launcherCommand/installArgv). Each entry needs the search command, every hit with a disposition, and a rollout line (immediate refusal naming what it closes, or warn-first).

The loader accepts an upper-case scheme (url.Parse lowercases it) and `//host/x.tgz` (path.IsAbs), which bunSpec then renders as `@sjawhar/pi-legion@HTTPS://…` or hands to bun as a path, so `legion start --check-config` passes a pair every stale relaunch's install fails on, into worker-died. Normalise once in readPluginSource (return the canonical form) or compare the scheme case-insensitively in bunSpec, with a config test for each spelling.

'Every undecodable request body is now logged `api: refused an undecodable request body` naming the route and the decoder's error' is false for the one case this change is for: readBody returns after the stale 409 (claims.go:312-313), which logs the stale Warn and never the decoder's error. Say 'every other undecodable body' (the spec's wording), or carry the decoder error on the stale Warn.

Deps.check validates Limits and Timeouts but not PluginContract, and 0 is also the legal 'none recorded' value of a claim: a Deps wired with PluginContract 0 and PluginRelaunchable true relaunches every current claim and charges from the second registration on. One row in the existing >= 1 loop closes it (daemon.go passes api.DaemonAPIVersion today).

The undecodable-body 409 is tested for the grants family only; claimSecretCheck (ready, exit) and redeemIdentityCheck (handoff/complete and the architect routes) have no undecodable-body case, so acceptance 5's second case is proven for one of three identity families.

observations: A moved-address relaunch at boot that also carries a stale plugin, when the configured image's plugin is itself stale (daemon restarted on the new release before the image was pinned): the replacement pod installs nothing, its process registers stale with PluginRelaunchFor already at the daemon's contract, so one launch failure is charged before the kept-pod install; ready resets it. Bounded; recorded, not a finding.
